candidate.role: medium-capacity open-weight challenger for retrieval-grounded Grow Doc evaluation

grow_doc_assessment.recommended_role: research-only challenger after the pinned Qwen3-8B base-vs-RAG experiment; potentially more practical than the 119B Mistral Small 4 quality-ceiling candidate for local quantized inference
advantages: 24B parameter scale is materially smaller than the 119B research ceiling candidate
128K context supports retrieval-grounded document and citation workloads
native multimodal capability may be relevant to later plant-image diagnostic evaluation
official model card explicitly positions the model for subject-matter-expert fine-tuning and reports quantized single-RTX-4090 deployment feasibility
blocking_requirements: freeze an exact model revision and tokenizer/processor revision
hash and review the exact prompt/chat-template contract
verify dependency versions and evaluator compatibility
establish and test an exact quantization and hardware/runtime contract
bind the candidate to the same frozen heldout_v2 and RAG snapshot contract
run the same factuality, diagnostic, hallucination, citation-accuracy, science, education, grounded-QA, and regression slices
demonstrate measured improvement before any training-target or adapter promotion
grow_doc_assessment.decision: Do not replace Qwen3-8B or spend fine-tuning compute on this candidate yet. Complete the controlled Qwen3-8B base-only versus identical base-plus-frozen-RAG benchmark first, then evaluate this candidate under a separately frozen runtime contract.
